packs.name: ClinVar
packs.description: Submitted clinical classifications, conditions, review status, and evaluation dates.
packs.attribution: ClinVar, National Center for Biotechnology Information, U.S. National Library of Medicine. Converted to an indexed local reference format; original assertions retained.
packs.coverage: Complete supplied ClinVar GRCh38 VCF dated 2026-09-05: precise-location variants only; all supplied GENEINFO symbols indexed. Excludes variants absent from the source VCF.

packs.name: dbSNP - chromosome 22 common variant identities
packs.description: Reference variant identifiers, assembly-specific alleles, and merged identifiers.
packs.attribution: dbSNP, National Center for Biotechnology Information, U.S. National Library of Medicine. Converted to an indexed local reference format.
packs.coverage: Official chr22 RefSNP records for 33,721 of 33,892 explicit rsIDs in the fixed public gnomAD 4.1.1 PASS/AF>=0.001 chr22 corpus; all documented GRCh37/GRCh38 alleles and available active-record merges. The 171 missing IDs are reported. Not genome-wide.

packs.name: gnomAD common variants - chromosome 22
packs.description: Allele counts, frequencies, ancestry-group frequencies, and source quality filters.
packs.attribution: Genome Aggregation Database (gnomAD), Broad Institute and contributing studies. Converted to an indexed local reference format. Population frequency is not an individual's ancestry or disease probability.
packs.coverage: gnomAD exomes 4.1.1 chromosome 22, GRCh38. Complete scan of 4,845,199 source rows; retain FILTER=PASS alleles with overall AF>=0.001 (38,854 source rows selected). This is a common-variant chromosome subset, not genome-wide or rare-variant coverage.

packs.name: GWAS Catalog
packs.description: Published variant–trait associations, reported effect sizes, study populations, and publications.
packs.license: EMBL-EBI Terms of Use (curated association data)
packs.attribution: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog. Converted curated associations; study findings are retained as variant context without inferring individual risk.
packs.coverage: Complete supplied GWAS Catalog curated association table dated 2026-09-04, fetched 2026-09-07; records with explicit rsIDs grouped for local lookup. Variant context only; unharmonized risk alleles and assembly are not inferred.

packs.name: Ensembl VEP 105 - chromosome 22 common variants
packs.description: Gene and transcript consequences, protein changes, and source prediction annotations.
packs.license: Ensembl data use policy; retain third-party constraints
packs.attribution: Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor, EMBL-EBI. Precomputed public reference variants; no user variants are sent to Ensembl.
packs.coverage: Ensembl VEP v105 consequences as distributed in gnomAD exomes 4.1.1 chromosome 22 (GRCh38), for source PASS alleles with AF>=0.001. Retains canonical or MANE transcript consequences and IDs; other transcripts, regulatory features and rare variants excluded. This is a pinned precomputed source, not the current Ensembl release.

packs.name: ClinPGx / PharmGKB
packs.description: Curated pharmacogenomic evidence, evidence levels, and drug-response annotations.
packs.attribution: ClinPGx / PharmGKB, Stanford University and contributing curators. Data converted to an indexed reference format; this derived data pack is distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. No endorsement is implied.
packs.coverage: Complete clinical annotation metadata table from CREATED_2025-07-05.txt. Genotype-specific allele text and full evidence tables are not imported. No individual drug response inferred.

packs.name: CPIC
packs.description: Gene–drug evidence levels and published guideline links where available, without inferring diplotypes or prescribing advice.
packs.attribution: Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium (CPIC), Stanford University and St. Jude Children's Research Hospital. Converted gene–drug reference data. Guidelines and content are subject to updates; consult the linked current guideline. No endorsement is implied.
packs.coverage: Complete paginated public CPIC pair_view gene-drug evidence metadata fetched 2026-09-07 (574 pairs). Some pairs do not have prescribing guidelines; real guideline links are retained when supplied. No diplotypes or prescribing rules are applied.

packs.name: ClinGen gene validity
packs.description: Expert-curated gene–disease validity classifications, inheritance, and expert panels.
packs.attribution: Clinical Genome Resource (ClinGen). Gene–Disease Validity classifications; source access date and release are recorded in provenance.json. Converted to indexed gene context with original classification, inheritance and curation links retained. No endorsement is implied.
packs.coverage: Complete supplied ClinGen gene–disease validity CSV rows with gene, HGNC, MONDO and curation identities. Includes limited, disputed and refuted classifications as well as stronger evidence. Gene context only; no personal disease or allele inference.

packs.name: Orphanet rare disease genes
packs.description: Rare-disease gene relationships, association types, assessment status, identifiers, and supporting publications.
packs.attribution: Orphadata Science: Free access data from Orphanet. © INSERM 1999. Available at https://sciences.orphadata.com/. XML data version is recorded in sourceRelease and provenance.json. Converted and indexed as gene context, retaining original relationship types, assessment status and references. No endorsement is implied.
packs.coverage: Complete supplied English Orphadata product 6 disorder–gene relationships with stable disorder, gene and association-type identifiers. Relationships are retained at the source's exact disease/subtype level, without inheritance propagation or inferred genomic alleles.

packs.name: UniProt curated human variants
packs.description: Literature-curated human protein substitutions, source categories, and disease or sample labels linked by rsID.
packs.attribution: UniProt Consortium, UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot humsavar. Converted to indexed rsID context; original protein feature identifiers, substitutions and source categories retained. Missing rsID rows are omitted and no genomic allele mapping is invented. No endorsement is implied.
packs.coverage: Every supplied humsavar row with a valid dbSNP rsID, including benign and uncertain categories; rows without rsIDs cannot be matched and are counted in provenance. Protein substitutions and disease/sample labels are reference context only: an rsID alone does not confirm the source protein substitution in a user's DNA.

packs.name: Open Targets — FinnGen neurological and Crohn disease fine-mapping
packs.description: Public GWAS credible-set variants, posterior probabilities, study effects, and ancestry context.
packs.attribution: Open Targets Platform and FinnGen R12. Converted public fine-mapping data; cite the linked source studies. Posterior inclusion probability is a model's causal-variant probability within a study, not an individual's disease probability. Studies and participants may overlap with other reference sources.
packs.coverage: Open Targets 26.06, FinnGen R12: all published 95% credible-set members for G6_ALZHEIMER (Alzheimer disease), G6_PARKINSON (Parkinson disease), and K11_CD_STRICT2 (strict Crohn disease). 46 credible sets, 3667 variant-membership annotations. GRCh38 only; study variant context, not personal risk. All other studies, 99%-only members, molQTLs and LD-neighbour tables excluded.

packs.name: Human Phenotype Ontology
packs.description: Disease-level clinical features, inheritance, frequency, negation and evidence linked through public gene–disease mappings.
packs.license: HPO custom license: attribution, version and unchanged source content/relationships
packs.attribution: This service/product uses the Human Phenotype Ontology (v2026-09-01). Human Phenotype Ontology Consortium; Köhler et al., 2014, doi:10.1093/nar/gkt1026. Find out more at https://www.human-phenotype-ontology.org. Original source rows and logical relationships are preserved; the pack is a local index, not a modified ontology.
packs.coverage: Complete supplied genes_to_disease and genes_to_phenotype tables, grouped by NCBI gene and disease ID. All phenotype.hpoa rows for those exact diseases are attached unchanged, including NOT, frequency, onset, sex, evidence and inheritance. Diseases with no source gene mapping are counted in provenance but cannot produce gene matches. No ontology ancestor expansion, MONDO merge, genomic allele inference or personal phenotype prediction.
